title: Degree of a cube product polynomial
statement: For natural numbers $n,a,d$, define a function on $\{-1,1\}^n$ by taking the product over $j=0,\ldots,d-1$ of $\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}x_i-\bigl(2(a+j)-n+1\bigr)$. Its Fourier degree is at most $d$.
